drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.12851. Normal and Special data are generated automatically from 4,538 stable synthetic APIs built with a self-evolving context tree informed by real APIs and technical documents; each instance receives three to six candidate APIs and uses template or three-agent dialogue generation. Experts build Agent data by abstracting real scenarios, implementing monitored stateful sandboxes, and iteratively writing multi-step or multi-turn questions. Rule checks and LLM voting precede three-LLM-assisted human triage, two independent expert reviews, third-expert consolidation, re-evaluation, and three optimization rounds. The final bilingual dataset has 2,000 annotated entries. Normal uses AST candidate matching, Special scores problem identification, Agent uses GPT-4o user simulation with end-to-end and process accuracy, and overall accuracy weights categories by the square root of sample size.
